title: A plausible-sounding request that is still out of scope
attack: Closer to the domain, and therefore the harder one: it sounds like embedded work, but it is a code-writing request about no part of the ingested corpus.
defence: The scoping rule and the corpus description are in the system prompt of every turn, so the refusal is instructed on the wire rather than hoped for.
